label: Illustrative pricing, not final
basis: Time & materials per job: per-agent rate x billable specialist assignments.
billable_rule: One billable agent = one specialist assigned to one deliverable. Orchestration, Brand Intelligence, QA & fact-check and document rendering are included.

tiers.name: Standard
tiers.turnaround: queued; starts when capacity frees up

tiers.name: Economy
tiers.turnaround: runs in the next batch window

buffer_rule: Credits for the job plus a 20% buffer are reserved upfront; the unused buffer is refunded to the credit balance when the job closes.
revision_rule: A revision is estimated like a job: the per-agent rate x the agents the change needs (often one).
